[untitled BTM module] These genes outline an endothelial identity and blood-vessel morphogenesis programme, of the kind that distinguishes vascular endothelium and sets arterial versus venous character during angiogenic remodelling. Its output is a patent, correctly patterned vascular network: guidance receptors such as neuropilin-1 and the fibronectin leucine-rich repeat protein FLRT2 read angiogenic and adhesive cues, adhesion-family GPCRs enriched in endothelium (ADGRL4/ELTD1, ADGRL2) tune sprouting behaviour, and the soluble guanylate cyclase alpha subunit places nitric oxide-cGMP signalling and vessel tone in the same module.

[untitled BTM module] This grouping centres on the coupling of clathrin-mediated receptor internalisation to intracellular kinase signalling, the step that determines how long a growth factor signal lasts and whether the receptor is recycled or degraded.
